summary: Proofbound reviewers must not take owner-gated lifecycle commands.
trigger: Legacy Koala owner-lease memory a6832a1 now applies to Proofbound/Lattice reviewer lanes.
lesson: Keep reviewers in read-only or reviewerWrite lanes. The story owner runs story-scoped mutating commands such as validate and story_advance unless a human explicitly transfers ownership.

summary: Proofbound delivery review must bind docs promises to real output.
trigger: Legacy Koala delivery-review memory f4fe749 now maps to Proofbound/Lattice delivery checks and DONE closure.
lesson: Before DONE, independently compare docs promises, real CLI or product transcripts, validation evidence, summaries, and unresolved findings. A delivery pass is useful only when it ties the promised user value to current machine evidence.
reusePrompt: At Proofbound TEST or DONE, apply the f4fe749 supersession: verify docs promises against real output and fresh evidence before closure.

summary: Proofbound review evidence must come from explicit reviewer lanes.
trigger: Legacy Koala reviewer-evidence memory c948c85 now applies to Proofbound/Lattice REVIEW gates and reviewer classifiers.
lesson: Reviewer evidence must be bound to an explicit reviewer lane, not inferred from main, implementer, or approximate agent names. Runtime classifiers and any mirrored guard paths must share the same reviewer-lane rules.
reusePrompt: When changing Proofbound review gates, apply the c948c85 supersession: verify reviewer-lane classification and block main/implementer evidence from counting as reviewer proof.

summary: Proofbound self-hosting CLI can lag until package dist is rebuilt.
trigger: Legacy Koala CLI-dist memory 2de5d6b now maps to Proofbound/Lattice self-hosting and global lattice binary verification.
lesson: During story development, verify new commands through the story worktree build. After merge, rebuild the canonical packages/main dist before trusting the global lattice binary or diagnosing unknown-command output.
reusePrompt: If a Proofbound/Lattice command exists in source but the CLI says unknown command, apply the 2de5d6b supersession: check dist freshness and the global lattice checkout.
